## I1
One-Sentence Story: Model cross-modal Laplacian-response residuals with a Student-t consistency prior and an input-dependent degradation operator to improve guided image super-resolution.
Theme: Cross-Domain Transfer
Form: new mechanism or new problem
Summary: Cross-modal guidance can transfer texture that does not correspond to the target signal, and fixed downsampling may misrepresent spatially varying degradation. The candidate statistically models guidance/target Laplacian-response differences with a Student-t prior, incorporates learned regularization and a Multiplicative Degradation (MD) operator, and unfolds the iterative solution into a network. The official code contains a fixed Laplacian filter, FFT updates, an H operator generated from observation/guidance/current reconstruction, and learned residual-prior and regularizer updates. H is an input-dependent spatial tensor; equivalence to a general dense physical degradation matrix is not established by code alone. Implementations cover RGB-guided depth SR, RGB-guided thermal SR and pansharpening, with nine named dataset configurations.
Available Results: The source abstract reports nine datasets across three tasks, improved performance, intermediate visualizations and guidance causal analysis. It does not supply effect sizes or matched controls; the full target paper is unavailable to this panel. No benchmark numbers have been reproduced.
Minimal Falsification Experiment: Evaluator-designed proposal, not the authors' reported historical experiment. Use a documented NYUv2 training split and held-out Middlebury/Lu depth sets at x4/x8, initially using existing bicubic degradation then a held-out family of spatially varying blur/downsampling. Two researchers and 2 A100-class GPUs for a one-week patch-training probe. Match data, backbone capacity, training schedule and seeds to DCTNet and a faithful reproduced DADA baseline. Within the candidate keep all else fixed and compare quadratic, Laplace and Student-t penalties on the same Laplacian residual; then run fixed-H/learned-H by prior-type factorial controls. Include an equal-capacity unconstrained fusion baseline. Expected signal is lower depth RMSE attributable separately to the prior and MD, with improved measurement consistency under held-out nonuniform degradation. A planning target is at least5% relative RMSE reduction against the strongest matched comparator on two held-out sets across three seeds. Kill the proposed reconstruction-benefit claim if better fitted residual likelihood gives no independent reconstruction gain; this does not falsify the residual distribution-fit observation itself, and kill MD adaptation if its advantage disappears outside training degradation or only tracks added capacity. These budget and thresholds are reconstructed planning assumptions, not observed paper results.
Why It May Be Novel: Laplacian-domain consistency, learned guidance weighting and unrolled reconstruction have precedents. The candidate's residual distinction is the Student-t statistical/robustness proposition, a forward degradation model and their attributable interaction across task families. Supplied prior work determines whether this constitutes a clear-accept contribution.
